admission.justification: Realized across role_launch_liveness.py (_reconcile_non_leaf) and role_retirement_receipt.py (settle_confirmed_replacement) and guarded by four ReplacementRetirementTests fixtures.

applicability: Native role_start launches that replace an existing non-leaf or leaf seat holder.
conditions: Replacement reserves the earlier seat's retirement intent before archiving and carries prior rejection or retirement state forward.
Attribution (retiredBy/retireReason) and held-message endings are committed on the exact predecessor receipt only after the host acknowledges archived or gone.
exclusions: Explicit retire_child calls, which use the direct retirement route.
Step-up launches that refuse rather than interrupt an active holder.

evidence: W2 expanded evidence E4, plus the prior execution 409 fixture.

statement: A replacing start reserves the earlier seat's retirement and records its attribution and held-message endings after the host confirms the exact predecessor was archived or gone.
title: Replacing starts reserve and settle predecessor retirement on host archive
